lyrics:
[Verse 1: a cappella, solo female voice, no instruments at all]
There's a bag beside the doorway
There's a note beside the bed
I have loved you past the saying
So I'll leave the rest unsaid

[Chorus: still a cappella, soft, a single held note]
I'm leaving you the light on
I'm leaving you the key
I'm leaving you the best years
That you ever gave to me
I'm leaving you the light

[Verse 2: soft electric piano, bass and brushes enter]
Take the laughing, take the summers
Take the kitchen and the songs
I am taking only this much:
That I loved you all along

[Chorus: fuller, strings join, voice opens up]
I'm leaving you the light on
I'm leaving you the key
I'm leaving you the best years
That you ever gave to me
I'm leaving you the light

[Saxophone Solo: tenor sax plays the chorus melody, tender]

[Verse 3: quiet, almost spoken, a blessing]
May the mornings treat you gently
May your table stay full
May somebody learn to hold you
In the way I never could

[Break: everything stops, silence, one huge drum hit]

[Final Chorus: key change up, full power, long held notes]
I'm leaving you the light on
I'm leaving you the key
I'm leaving you the best years
That you ever gave to me
I'm leaving you the light
Oh, I'm leaving you the light

[Outro: band fades, voice alone again, very soft]
The light
I'm leaving you
Tonight
